atoms.text:
Basketball is a ball sport that is played in two teams. Each team has up to twelve players of which only five can actively play on the court.
Basketball is played in quarters of 10 minutes each.
After the first and the third quarter, there's a two-minute break.
After the second quarter, there's a 15-minute-long half-time break.
If the last quarter ends in a draw, the game continues with five-minute-long overtimes.
Between each overtime there's also a break of two minutes.

instruction.text: Lies die Texte und beantworte anschließend die Fragen.

atoms.text: The basketball court is divided into two symmetrical halves. The goal is to get the ball into the basket of the opposite half of the court. Whenever a team has the basketball, they have 24 seconds to score.

The court is framed by the side lines and the baselines. The middle of the court is marked by the half-court line. On each side of the court there is a backboard and a basket. The players try to throw the ball into the basket of the other team.

hint.text: to be framed by sth. – von etwas umrandet sein
hint.sound: to be framed by something <voice voiceLang='de' voice='m3'>bedeutet von etwas umrandet sein.</voice>

atoms.a: How much time does a team have to score?
What's the name of the line that marks the middle of the court?
How many baskets are on the court?

atoms.text: When a player has the ball, they need to dribble it if they want to move. It's against the rules to hold the ball and take more than two steps without dribbling. This violation of the rules is called “travel”.

hint.sound: violation <voice voiceLang='de' voice='m3'>bedeutet Verstoß.</voice> travel <voice voiceLang='de' voice='m3'>bedeutet Schrittfehler.</voice>

atoms.text: If a player scores by throwing the ball from the purple area, the team gets three points.

atoms.text: If a player scores by throwing the ball from the orange area, the team gets two points.
